summary.en: A sacred journey to Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath through the Garhwal Himalayas.
summary.kn: ಗಢ್ವಾಲ್ ಹಿಮಾಲಯದ ಮೂಲಕ ಯಮುನೋತ್ರಿ, ಗಂಗೋತ್ರಿ, ಕೇದಾರನಾಥ ಮತ್ತು ಬದರಿನಾಥಕ್ಕೆ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಯಾತ್ರೆ.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Haridwar
itinerary.description: Pickup and transfer to hotel, evening Ganga Aarti.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Barkot
itinerary.description: Drive through the Shivalik range towards Yamunotri base.

faqs.question: Is the Chardham Yatra suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes, with our helicopter and palanquin options for Kedarnath, senior citizens complete the yatra comfortably every year.

reviews.author: Suresh K.
reviews.comment: Extremely well organized, our parents had a smooth darshan.

description.en: Book the 11-day Chardham Yatra with Hindustan Yathra — Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath.
description.kn: ಹಿಂದೂಸ್ತಾನ್ ಯಾತ್ರಾ ಜೊತೆ 11 ದಿನಗಳ ಚಾರ್‌ಧಾಮ್ ಯಾತ್ರೆ ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ.

summary.en: 6 days of private villas, sunset cruises and temple hopping across Bali for newlyweds.
summary.kn: ನವವಿವಾಹಿತರಿಗಾಗಿ ಬಾಲಿಯಾದ್ಯಂತ ಖಾಸಗಿ ವಿಲ್ಲಾ, ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತ ಪ್ರವಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ದೇವಾಲಯ ಭೇಟಿಯ 6 ದಿನಗಳು.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali
itinerary.description: Private transfer to villa, welcome dinner.

faqs.question: Do Indian citizens need a visa for Bali?
faqs.answer: Indonesia offers visa-on-arrival for Indian passport holders for short stays; we assist with the process.

reviews.author: Anitha & Rakesh
reviews.comment: Best honeymoon planning we could have asked for.

description.en: 6-day Bali honeymoon package with private villas and sunset cruises.
description.kn: ಖಾಸಗಿ ವಿಲ್ಲಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತ ಕ್ರೂಸ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ 6-ದಿನದ ಬಾಲಿ ಹನಿಮೂನ್ ಪ್ಯಾಕೇಜ್.
